questions.questionText: What problem did ResNet's residual connections solve?
options: They made CNNs work on color images for the first time
Beyond a certain depth, plain stacked CNNs got harder to train (a form of vanishing gradient); shortcut connections let much deeper networks train reliably
They eliminated the need for pooling layers
They removed the need for labeled training data
questions.correctAnswer: Beyond a certain depth, plain stacked CNNs got harder to train (a form of vanishing gradient); shortcut connections let much deeper networks train reliably
questions.explanation: Residual connections let a layer's input skip ahead and add directly to its output, which solved the degradation problem that made very deep plain CNNs difficult to train.

questions.questionText: In transfer learning's "feature extraction" approach, what do you actually train?
options: The entire network from random weights
Only a new final classification layer, while the pretrained convolutional layers stay frozen
Only the very first convolutional layer
Nothing — feature extraction requires no training at all
questions.correctAnswer: Only a new final classification layer, while the pretrained convolutional layers stay frozen
questions.explanation: Feature extraction reuses the pretrained network's already-learned general visual features unchanged, and only trains a new layer on top for the specific target classes.

questions.questionText: Why is transfer learning so widely used in practice instead of training CNNs from scratch?
options: Training from scratch is technically impossible
Early CNN layers learn broadly general-purpose visual features (edges, textures), which are wasteful to re-derive from a small dataset when a pretrained network already has them
Transfer learning always produces a smaller model file
It's required by law for computer vision applications
questions.correctAnswer: Early CNN layers learn broadly general-purpose visual features (edges, textures), which are wasteful to re-derive from a small dataset when a pretrained network already has them
questions.explanation: Since a huge labeled dataset and heavy compute are needed to learn good general features from scratch, reusing an already-trained network's early layers is far more practical for most projects.
